dedupe_keys.name: dartmouth atlas of health care data hospital service areas hospital referral regions and medicare utilisation rates united states

description: This resource is the data site of the Dartmouth Atlas of Health Care, which for more than 25 years documented variation in how medical resources were distributed and used across the United States using Medicare and Medicaid data. The Dartmouth Institute for Health Policy and Clinical Practice produced it. It holds the Atlas's healthcare geography, the hospital service areas and hospital referral regions built from where Medicare patients were treated, with yearly ZIP code crosswalks from 2000 onwards and boundary files, and area rates of hospital beds, physician supply, spending, utilisation and end-of-life care, downloadable longitudinally, by year or as a custom selection, plus coding trend files. Coverage is national at hospital service area and referral region level. Files are free CSV, Excel and zipped boundary downloads, and research users are directed to archived versions with DOIs; the site is copyright of the Trustees of Dartmouth College. Caveats: the project has ended and data will no longer be updated, rates cover fee-for-service Medicare only, and service areas reflect historical patient flows. Simulation uses: defining hospital catchments and referral networks for healthcare capacity and surge models, allocating patients to hospitals in disruption scenarios, and mapping bed supply against population. Related records: the HRSA Area Health Resources Files (data-hrsa-area-health-resources-files) give county health resources and AHRQ HCUP (data-ahrq-hcup-hospital-utilization-databases) give hospital utilisation.
